tool_signatures.name: read
tool_signatures.description: Read a file, returning as few tokens as possible. For 2+ files, use `batch_read`.

path.description: File path (absolute, or relative to the project root). Use an absolute path for files outside the project root.

max_size.description: Byte threshold above which a map of the file is returned instead of its text; read exact lines with `offset`/`limit`.

offset.description: 1-based first line for a ranged read; omit or pass 0 to start from the first line.

limit.description: Number of lines to return starting at `offset`.

known_hash.description: The `content_hash` from your last read of this file — or the `coverage_token` from your last ranged read of it — passed back to get `"unchanged"` instead of the content re-sent. Omit only on a first read, or when you no longer hold what it vouches for.

outline.description: Return the file's definitions and their line numbers instead of its text. Cannot be combined with `offset`/`limit`.

line_numbers.description: Prefix each line of a ranged read with its number. Costs about 17% more tokens; the range is in `lines` either way. Requires `offset` or `limit`.
